_comment: Mock property listings for the Beşiktaş prototype (CAPAAA-5). Each listing is keyed to a real osm_id from data/besiktas-buildings.geojson. Photos are deterministic picsum.photos seeds so the demo looks consistent on every reload. Replace with real listings in v1.

listings.title: Penthouse · Bereket Apartmanı
listings.description: Top-floor penthouse with 360° Bosphorus and old-city views. Private rooftop terrace, two parking spots, smart-home wiring throughout.

listings.title: 3+1 · Simotas Binası
listings.description: Renovated mid-century apartment two streets from the Bosphorus. South-facing living room, original parquet, modernised kitchen and bathrooms.

listings.title: 2+1 · Kevser Apt
listings.description: Bright two-bedroom rental in Ortabayır. Furnished, white-goods included, balcony with side view of the valley. 12-month lease, 2 months deposit.

listings.title: 1+1 · Köknar Apt
listings.description: Quiet 1+1 ideal for a single tenant or couple. Recent paint and flooring, gas combi heating, unfurnished.

listings.title: 2+1 · Neziroğlu Apt
listings.description: Off-market opportunity in Ortabayır. Owner is taking quiet offers ahead of a broader listing in Q3.

listings.title: Branded Residence · Dedeman tower
listings.description: Serviced apartment in the Dedeman tower above Gayrettepe. 24-hour concierge, fitness centre, spa, valet parking. Sold furnished.

listings.title: 3+1 · Şairler 7
listings.description: Walking distance to Levent metro and Zorlu Center. Open-plan living, en-suite master, large balcony facing Şairler.

listings.title: 2+1 · Şairler 5
listings.description: Furnished corporate rental, perfect for executives relocating to the Levent business district. Pet friendly, parking included.

listings.title: 1+1 · Şairler 3

listings.title: 2+1 · Talatpaşa 2

listings.title: 3+1 · Venüs A-Blok
